notes: Itinerary performance fix: legacy whole-page MutationObservers are now disabled completely; startup renderers still run their normal initial/delayed passes and explicit click handlers, but no background DOM watchers remain. Attraction catalog grouping fix now supports the current spot-* card IDs as well as v2-* IDs, so Matsumoto Projection and AEON Matsumoto move to Matsumoto, Mountain Harbor and White Park move to Hakuba, and Takayama supermarket moves to Takayama. Empty Other group is removed.
